page.overview:
Who is Hamad Al Fardan?

= Hamad Al Fardan = Hamad Al Fardan (born 29 June 1987) is a Bahraini racing driver known for his participation in various international motorsport competitions, particularly in touring cars and single-seater racing categories. He is regarded as one of Bahrain's pioneering professional racing drivers and has contributed significantly to raising the profile of motorsport in the Gulf region. He is the first Bahraini to drive at GP2 Series level.

Hamad Al Fardan was born in Bahrain in 1987, the son of rally driver Ahmed Al Fardan. From a young age, he showed an interest in motorsports, eventually pursuing a career as a racing driver. His involvement helped pave the way for greater motorsport participation and development in Bahrain, a country that later became notable for hosting a Formula One Grand Prix.

Al Fardan began his racing career in regional and national competitions, gradually making his way into higher-profile racing series. His early experience was primarily focused on touring cars and formula racing.

Hamad Al Fardan competed in various international racing series, including the British Formula 3 Championship, where he gained valuable experience against strong competition.
